home.heroBody: A warm spiritual home for Tamil Catholic families across British Columbia — rooted in faith, family, and fellowship.
home.welcomeBody: Whether you are a long-time member or a newcomer to British Columbia, you have a place with us. We gather in worship, support one another as families, and celebrate our Tamil Catholic heritage together.
home.faithBody: Christ at the centre of all we do.
home.familyBody: Every household belongs and is supported.
home.communityBody: Tamil heritage, shared in unity and service.

about.title: About Us
about.storyBody: How Tamil Catholic families across BC came together to worship and support one another.
about.missionBody: To nurture faith, family, and Tamil Catholic heritage in a welcoming community.
about.visionBody: A connected family where every household finds belonging and a spiritual home.

prayer.title: Prayer Requests
prayer.intro: Share your intentions with our community. Our coordinators gather requests and our priests remember them at Holy Mass.
prayer.confidential: Confidential — requests are seen only by coordinators and clergy, never published on the website.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.location: We gather across the Greater Vancouver area. See Events for the next Mass location.
